app.name: Hisab Ki Kitab
app.footerTagline: Hisab Ki Kitab - money that lasts the whole month, for a hostel room or a household.

mode.label: Finance mode
mode.question: How do you want to manage your finances?
mode.studentDescription: Manage pocket money, hostel expenses, education and personal savings.
mode.householderDescription: Manage household income, bills, groceries, family expenses and savings.
mode.switchBody: Your {current} records stay exactly where they are. You will see them again the moment you switch back.

settings.title: Settings
settings.financeModeHint: Switch between three separate sets of books. Nothing is deleted when you switch.
settings.languageHint: Changes the words on screen. Your records are untouched.
settings.categoriesSubtitle: Add your own on top of the built-in ones
settings.appearanceSubtitle: Dark mode is easier on the eyes in a hostel room at 2am
settings.subtitle: Your profile, your categories, your data.
settings.incomeHint: You can change this any time in Settings

onboarding.chooseMode: How do you want to manage your finances?
onboarding.chooseLanguage: Which language would you like to use?
onboarding.incomeQuestionStudent: How much do you have to work with each month? Pocket money, allowance, part-time pay - the total you expect to receive.
onboarding.incomeQuestionHouseholder: How much does the household have to work with each month? Salary, business, rent, money sent from abroad - the total you expect to receive.
onboarding.currencyFirst: Pick your currency first, then the amount.
onboarding.enterIncomeStudent: Enter your monthly pocket money to continue
onboarding.enterIncomeHouseholder: Enter your monthly household income to continue
onboarding.goalIntroStudent: Saving works much better with a target. Pick one of these or write your own.
onboarding.goalIntroHouseholder: A household saves better with a target. Pick one of these or write your own.
onboarding.placeIntro: Optional, but it makes the AI advice sound less like a robot and more like a senior from your hostel.

auth.demoFilled: Demo details filled in. Hit Log in.

auth.resetSubtitleShort: Pick something you have not used anywhere else.

authShell.headline: Make the money last the whole month.
authShell.lede: Built in Pakistan, for a hostel room and for a household - small budgets, fixed bills, and everything in between.
authShell.knowText: Mess or rashan, chai or bijli - every rupee in one place.
authShell.coachText: Advice written from your own numbers, for the life you actually live.
authShell.leaksText: Budgets warn you before the month runs out, not after.
authShell.dataIsYours: Your data stays yours. Export or delete everything from Settings, any time.
authShell.reachOut: Something broken or an idea to share? Reach {name}:

goals.subtitle: Money with a name attached is much harder to spend by accident.

advisor.title: AI Advisor
advisor.subtitleConfigured: Advice written from your actual expenses, budgets and goals{model}.
advisor.subtitleOffline: No API key on the server, so the built-in rule-based advisor is answering.
advisor.coachSubtitle: Answers based on your real spending
advisor.askAnything: Ask me anything about your money
advisor.askAnythingDetail: I can see your expenses, budgets and goals, so the answers are about your actual numbers.
advisor.suggestSaveMore: How can I save more this month?
advisor.suggestFoodStudent: Is my food spending normal for a hostel student?
advisor.suggestBillsHouseholder: Are my utility bills higher than they should be?
advisor.suggestTargetStudent: Help me save 5000 before next month
advisor.suggestTargetHouseholder: Help me cut 5000 from next month without touching the bills

advisor.tipUnavailableHouseholder: Write down every household expense for three days straight - bills and bazaar trips both. You cannot cut what you cannot see.
